verdicts.reason: A and B are almost the same layout, and both have the same problems. The 'NEW YORK' ribbon is much larger than the 'SUBWAY' and 'GUIDE' ribbons, which breaks the original's evenly sized three-line title stack. The gaps between the ribbons are uneven. The diagonal stripe graphics have broken into floating grey and beige shapes that sit on top of the photo at the lower right. A faint translucent shape also collides with the 'SUB' lettering at the lower left. A has slightly tighter ribbon spacing and B has slightly looser spacing, but neither one is better than the other.
